name: SPC-NeRF
aliases: Spatial Predictive Compression for Voxel-Based Radiance Field
definition: A Rate-Distortion (RD) optimized predictive coding framework for compressing Explicit Voxel Grid (EVG) represented NeRFs. It removes spatial redundancy by predicting voxel values from adjacent voxels and jointly optimizes compression ratio and distortion during training.
